releases.body:
## What's Changed

### Features

- **security**: gate shell expansion by command scope and redact subprocess stderr
- **security**: add config keys and shared redaction/containment primitives

### Bug Fixes

- **security**: default auto-update to notify-only and verify integrity before install
- **security**: make document_reader opt-in and block non-file/SSRF URIs
- **security**: 0600 log file, bounded rotation, redacted entries
- **security**: apply scope policy to slash-command expansion in both call sites
- **security**: contain file references within the command root and cap size
- **security**: fail closed on archive integrity and validate zip members
- **deps**: raise vulnerable ranges, pin transitive fixes, cap frontmatter size
- **plan-persister**: serialize plan sync and hold the task lock across it
- **task-lock**: atomic stale reclaim, pid liveness, refresh, and a typed exhaustion error
- **observability**: log truncation and transcript parse drops
- **io-loudness**: log skipped session, recovery, and handoff reads
- **matrix-loop**: export per-session helpers from the barrel
- **event-dispatch**: keyed concurrent pump so one session cannot stall the others
- **context-injection**: peek before clearing pending context
- **matrix-loop**: fail closed on verification timeout and bound the verification prompt
- **plan-writes**: atomic writes and surfaced failures across plan, hashline, and reconcile
- **task-storage**: fsync task writes and count corrupt reads
- **assembly-state**: remove the duplicated state mutation and log
- **skill-pack**: old-rename-rm install so a crash cannot destroy a working install
- **tmux**: bound pane and path probe spawns with kill-on-timeout
- **fan-out**: settle tool-execute-before wave 1, BDD stages, and assembly voters
- **tool-execute-after**: isolate per-hook failures so one hook cannot cancel the chain
- **matrix-loop**: per-session state files and a serialized increment
- **session-state**: stable main-session election and live subagent registry
- **mission-state**: unique tmp path, fsync, and typed result for atomic writes

### Documentation

- **security**: document hardening knobs and defaults

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #118 from klpanagi/perf/optimizations
- perf(io): async hook-message writes; single comment-scan temp dir; bounded caches
- perf(plugin): indexed event dispatch and parallel observer waves
- perf(session-recovery): make message storage writes async
- perf(hooks): gate rtk passthrough and batch gitleaks staged scan
- perf(rules-injector): cache rules discovery and parse results
- perf(skills): lazy-load builtin skills and split plugin bundle
- Merge pull request #117 from klpanagi/fix/security-hardening
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/dev' into fix/security-hardening
- Merge pull request #116 from klpanagi/fix/bugs-remediation

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.5.1...v1.5.2

## What's Changed

### Features

- **ast-grep**: checksum-verify downloaded binaries before install
- **tools**: add comment_scan
- **comment-scan**: in-process comment scanner

### Bug Fixes

- **ast-grep**: give the sg launcher its engine path at spawn

### Refactoring

- **commands**: rename /plan-review to /completion-review
- **comment-checker**: scan in-process, drop the external binary

### Documentation

- correct hook-dir and source/test file counts
- comment-scan architecture and counts

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #115 from klpanagi/refactor/rename-completion-review
- Merge pull request #114 from klpanagi/feat/comment-scan-consolidation

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

## What's Changed

### Features

- **doctor**: add skill-pack checks; docs and policy carve-out
- **sati**: add design-system protocol and skill selector
- **uiux**: add uiux_search, uiux_design_system, uiux_validate
- **skill-packs**: expose installed packs to skill tool, agents, host
- **skill-packs**: add install pipeline and matrixx skill CLI
- **skill-packs**: add pack catalog, config schema, frontmatter parser, store
- **commands**: add /academic-humanize builtin command
- **scripts**: export builtin skills as a SkillEvaluator catalog
- feat(config)!: add pinnedFiles, drop secret excludes, skip unset-variable hubs
- **knowledge-hub**: clear injector cache on compaction and delete
- **knowledge-hub**: build injector deps, gate registration, unify LoadedHub

### Bug Fixes

- **skills**: stop quoting real credentials in security-secrets
- **knowledge-hub**: validate confirm target, session, and exact approval
- **knowledge-hub**: harden write guard, bash analysis, approvals bounds
- **agents**: point the shared prompt builder at registered agents
- **skills**: remove fabricated runtimes, APIs and runner directives from builtin skills
- **agents**: repair stale references and gate GPT-only prompt sections
- **commands**: replace retired agent names in command templates
- **hooks**: gate notepad and niobe after-hooks on the native subagent tool
- **hooks**: drop removed agent and tool names from injected messages
- **agents**: hydrate skill descriptions in the available-skills table
- **mcp**: surface built-in MCP tools in prompts and correct tool names
- **agents,skills,tests**: remove stale practices and hallucinated references

### Refactoring

- **knowledge-hub**: single directive, aggregate cap, dedupe repair
- refactor(knowledge-hub)!: remove dead legacy injector hook

### Documentation

- **skill-packs**: document prerequisites and quick start
- **commands**: document /academic-humanize, refresh command counts to 24
- **knowledge-hub**: align docs with native injector and residual bypasses
- align long-form documentation with the current code
- **agents-md**: correct factual drift across the AGENTS.md cascade
- **hooks**: correct stale wave counts in the tool.execute.before dispatcher
- align docs and instruction files with current source

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #113 from klpanagi/docs/skill-pack-prereqs
- Merge pull request #112 from klpanagi/feat/skill-packs
- Merge pull request #111 from klpanagi/feat/academic-humanize
- Merge pull request #110 from klpanagi/feat/skill-eval
- Merge pull request #109 from klpanagi/fix/knowledge-hub-remediation
- Merge pull request #108 from klpanagi/fix/audit-consistency
- Merge pull request #107 from klpanagi/fix/context7-mcp-visibility
- Merge pull request #106 from klpanagi/fix/docs-consistency-audit

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.4.2...v1.5.0

- **tools**: stop teaching the removed background argument in runtime strings
- **hooks,plan-contract**: drop background argument from injected strings

### Documentation

- drop background argument claims across docs and AGENTS.md

- **agents**: rewrite delegation prompts onto async rendezvous doctrine

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #105 from klpanagi/fix/background-subagents-v2
- Merge pull request #104 from klpanagi/fix/audit-consistency-2
- perf(skills): exclude matrixx-self-config from all agents by default

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2

- **consistency**: align prompts, skills, hooks, and tests with the code

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #103 from klpanagi/fix/audit-consistency-2
